verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that skills trigger automatically (gh-11). A session-start bootstrap tells the agent to invoke relevant skills before any response (docs-16, docs-26, docs-28), with context-to-skill routing such as "Fix this bug" → systematic-debugging (docs-77), and auto-triggering is carried across harnesses (docs-59, docs-7). Skill text is pressure-tested with subagent scenarios, and an eval harness judges skill compliance in real sessions (docs-15, docs-30). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the right skill actually fires at the right moment, and explicit guidance on how skill descriptions are worded to drive activation.
